description: This file defines the SearchParameters class used to encapsulate search criteria in the FinDirect project. It provides fields for various search filters such as officeId, externalId, name, hierarchy, status, date ranges, and other relevant parameters. It includes logic for default and boundary value handling, as well as utility methods to check if certain filters are active.

classes.name: SearchParameters
classes.description: A class encapsulating search filters for querying entities in the Fineract system, supporting pagination, sorting, and filtering by multiple criteria.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the effective limit for search results, defaulting to DEFAULT_MAX_LIMIT if not set, and null if an unlimited (zero or negative) limit is specified.

methods.name: getOrphansOnly
methods.description: Returns whether only orphaned entities should be included in the search, interpreting the Boolean field accordingly.

methods.name: getIsSelfUser
methods.description: Returns whether the search pertains to the self user, based on the isSelfUser flag.

methods.name: hasOrderBy
methods.description: Checks if an order by field has been specified.

methods.name: hasSortOrder
methods.description: Checks if a sort order has been specified.

methods.name: hasOfficeId
methods.description: Determines if an office ID filter is active.

methods.name: hasCurrencyCode
methods.description: Checks if a currency code filter is set.

methods.name: hasLimit
methods.description: Checks if a limit has been explicitly set and is greater than zero.

methods.name: hasOffset
methods.description: Determines if an offset for pagination is specified.

methods.name: hasHierarchy
methods.description: Checks if a hierarchy filter is specified.

methods.name: hasStaffId
methods.description: Determines if a staff ID filter is active.

methods.name: hasLoanId
methods.description: Determines if a loan ID filter is active.

methods.name: hasSavingsId
methods.description: Determines if a savings account ID filter is active.

methods.name: hasProvisioningEntryId
methods.description: Checks if a provisioning entry ID filter is active.

methods.name: hasProductId
methods.description: Checks if a product ID filter is active.

methods.name: hasCategoryId
methods.description: Checks if a category ID filter is active.

methods.name: isPerson
methods.description: Returns true if the legalForm indicates a person.

methods.name: isEntity
methods.description: Returns true if the legalForm indicates an entity.

methods.name: hasLegalForm
methods.description: Checks if a legal form filter has been specified.
